3f:T4d5,Customer stated that when he is driving in Efficient Mode, he always switches off Auto Start/Stop but it still seems like the car is shutting off. Writer asked if he notices this with any of the other Driving Modes. Customer stated no, he sets it to Efficient Mode every time he drives. Writer asked how he is turning Auto Start/Stop off. Customer stated that when he gets in, he presses the MY Modes button, selects Efficient Mode on the screen, then swipes down from the right side of the display and taps the Auto Start/Stop icon in the upper right corner to disable it. Customer was very clear that he repeats this process every time he starts a trip. Writer asked if he could go out to the car, but customer stated he could not. Writer advised that on the Instrument Cluster there is a power gauge on the right side of the display, and when Auto Start/Stop is still active and he is stopped, it will show 0 or Ready. Customer confirmed this. Customer mentioned the dealership Genius had offered to come to his home for a tutorial. Writer advised that they would normally schedule an RVG session, but in this particular case it would likely work better for the Genius to sit in the car with him so he can feel it and see it together.40:T6db,this is my 5th bmw vehicle.
all of my earlier bmws were bought new and then swapped out for another one in under 4 years, in this order:
550i
540i
740i
550i
now a 530i
i realize i am now in the regular 5 series, which i chose because, in my view, quality and functionality have gone backwards overall. that is not just about this 530 compared to those older cars.
my issues are:
run flat tires mostly gone and no spare?
1) putting a 4 cylinder motor in any 5 series
2) air conditioning feels downgraded and not strong enough for south texas heat
3) ac/vent fan is too noisy except on the lowest level. with the fan high, you basically cant talk on the phone.
4) auto stop/start, but the driver does not have simple, effective full control to switch it off.
5) ventilated seats fan seems weaker, airflow reduced
6) not enough storage. the small latched compartment by the driver is gone, there is a phone charging pad instead of extra storage depth (should be removable), and the glove box is limited and does not work well.
7) everything is "touch" instead of "press". i would rather have push buttons for lock/unlock or some audible lock/unlock feedback.
8) windshield washer fluid coming through the wipers, which often clog, instead of separate exterior spray points.
those are some problems with the car itself. i also have customer service and process concerns with the austin tx dealership on lakeshore rd.
my current 530 was bought from horizon automotive in san antonio. my previous 4 bmws came from trailway automotive group in austin.
